scope: First actual-Rawstep-input evaluation on two pre-reserved pages and whole histories after train-only correction. The preferences task checks enabled/pressed state transitions and a final saved outcome. The separate link composition is fixture health, not user-task success. Independent Native AX/visible-target/context/command/receipt checks retain unknown inputs. Reading-target outline joins are narrower than general logical-cursor Navigation Accuracy; keyboard focus and declared state fields/transitions remain separate. No representative-web or queue/completion/timing parity claim. Both profiles completed before outcome inspection. Now inspected regression.

reservation.purpose: Reserve distinct input pages and full histories before Native hint calibration; model predictions will be sealed after any train-only correction and before transfer Native.

plan.sourceState: Collection worktree with pending evaluator diagnostics and the speech-input observation method; full source/build hashes retained, not a pristine commit build.
plan.question: Does train-only title/help/context correction transfer to a previously reserved preferences state task and a separate three-link reading composition?
plan.hypothesis: Keep each complete reserved group/history separate. Native input equivalence, reading target, focus, state and final task outcomes are independent checks. No source or model change or one-profile outcome inspection until both Native profiles finish.
plan.protocol: Same shared HTML and complete command sequences in both Native browsers. Freeze actual Rawstep model outputs, semantic inputs, previous speech contexts and independent renderer DOM/control state before Native. Rawstep owns movement; no new navigation implementation. Speech data never selects targets or supplies model inputs.
plan.inputPolicy: Preserve exact diagnostic input and previousContext. For the Native verifier only, join the actual model target backendDOMNodeId to its independently read renderer DOM id; retain both original identity and mapping. This ID-only verification view does not alter model input or prediction. Container IDs retain actual model identities. Native target and previous ancestor context still require independent geometry/AX confirmation.
metrics: literal Full Speech Exact of actual model windows
plan.limits: Two pages and whole histories reserved before train Native, with no declared group/full-sequence collision; shared primitives are limited composition transfer, not representative web sampling. The preferences page has a real final save/state oracle; the link reading page is fixture health and must not count as a successful user task. A diagnostic input is not an AX/VO cursor oracle. Model 900ms observation windows and Native bounded receipt windows do not establish equal timing, causal attribution, completion or native queue behavior. Preserve every failed/missing/unmeasured row.

acquisition.scope: Actual-input test on two pre-reserved pages, fixed current model and all predictions before either Native profile. Both browsers must finish before outcome inspection or changes. One real state/save task and one read-only fixture-health composition; no pooled task-success claim.

preNativeObserverRepair.reason: Targeted tests caught a duplicate local focusMove declaration in the checker after the model-prediction freeze. Removed the duplicate before any transfer Native observation. This checker is not called by the model-prediction freezer; model JS and all predictions remain unchanged. Original plan and its source hashes are preserved.
